verdict.rationale: Rippling IT ships AI features such as 'Ask Rippling AI', so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence shows it can connect to external MCP servers and use their tools. The probe documents an official Rippling MCP server, which is the server role and a different story, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
